title: Case-insensitive text
description: The greeting rule finds hello regardless of case.

title: Hex pattern with a gap
description: The hex rule finds MZ, two intervening bytes, and hello at byte 0.

title: Regex counts and offsets
description: Two numeric IDs occur; the second starts at byte 6.

title: Occurrence with a false condition
description: hello occurs, but the input is shorter than the condition requires.

title: Evidence: complete credential
description: One endpoint, username, and secret form a ready finding. No credential validation is performed.
rules:
rule credential {
 strings:
  $user = /username=([^ \r\n]+)/ capture(username = 1)
  $host = /endpoint=([^ \r\n]+)/ capture(endpoint = 1)
  $pass = /password=([^ \r\n]+)/ capture(secret = 1)
 evidence:
  account = (endpoint, username, secret) within 96 of secret
 condition:
  $pass
}
